Nvidia Shares Surge, Boosting Nasdaq and AI Stocks

Nvidia shares experienced a significant surge of approximately 30%, reaching $167.04, following the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO. This rally contributed to a broader uplift in the US stock market, with the Nasdaq index climbing around 5% and the tech-heavy Nasdaq-100 poised to add over $2 trillion in market value. AI-related stocks also saw substantial gains, with companies like Google, Meta, Microsoft, SpaceX, and AMD rising up to 9%. Bernstein maintained a $200 target for Nvidia shares, seeing further upside potential.
